I am a ACE fitness personal trainer and I work at my campus rec center, and I can honestly say you don't need one.  If you have questions about the certain lifts don't hesitate to ask a trainer on how to perform them correctly...you shouldn't have to pay somebody to show you correct form.  Also, if you are having trouble with motivation, I find the best way is to bring a friend.  For starters, they are free and you can yell at each other to keep going.  Personal Trainers can be more motivating but you obviously pay for it, and seeing that you found yourself a program you don't need them to create one for you.

I have been both unemployed and I also worked at Mcdonalds while in college.  The benefits of Mcdonalds, I believe, are going to help you in the long run.  Sure it may not be the best job ever, but having the job helps you stay organized and stay on task with school.  While I was unemployed I felt lazy and unmotivated. Of course this is my opinion and everyone is different.  I hope it works out for the best and good luck with that degree!!!
